steps.content: Rays of light plummet like frantic executioners struggling to contain a furious madman. The leviathan is pinned to the ground, unable to break free, but it still lets out a roar so loud it could burst eardrums. Light erupts from within its body, wildly shattering the very fabric of space itself.

The rift leading to Mania keeps widening. Christina is gripped by an agonizing headache as a torrent of emotional sensations floods her mind, engulfing her before violently ejecting her. She's in a realm of pure mental chaos, where her sense of self is continuously breaking apart, relentlessly eroded.

Amidst the chaos, she instinctively releases Coquelic's hand and rushes back to find Shalom. But in this moment and place, humans are insignificant—a forceful streak of light swings her way, casting her aside like a solitary leaf.
As she distances herself, she finally sees that soft figure.

Shalom is consumed by Mania, impaled by lances of light. She lifts her gaze to Christina, witnessing the young girl's struggle as she shouts her name, only to be relentlessly pushed back by berserk beams of light. She takes no action, seemingly numb, as if in a state of waiting.

At last, a shadowy figure catches Christina from behind, the luminescent edge of a familiar blade severing all the menacing beams of light that imperiled her. Observing this from a distance, Shalom smiles, her lips quivering subtly; Christina can't quite make out what she's saying.
She senses a momentary hesitation from the person holding her from behind, and then she decisively leads Christina away from the surrounding chaos.
As everything goes white, a massive triangle materializes within the space. Blue spikes of light rain down from it like a torrent, wholly consuming both the roaring leviathan and the silent Hush.

As Christina's consciousness fragments while regaining awareness, she can't make out her surroundings. What she does see are vivid red and icy blue spikes piercing her body. This is the disruption that broke out in the real world when the two forces clashed. She too was affected when she intruded upon the scene.
From the indistinct distance, the clamor of a fierce battle resonates.

steps.speaker: HUSH Combat Force
steps.content: X is encountering anomalies, draining ahead of schedule. Activate emergency eradication protocol—Eliminate all! Eliminate all!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Christina, where are they? Tell me! Where are they?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Are you dead, kiddo?!

Another burst of intense gunfire erupts, only to be abruptly silenced by the crash of heavy metal. Multiple grunts from Hush elites suggest they've been thrown off balance. Christina hears a familiar voice.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Mission update. Paradeisos's proxy will arrive to retrieve the worn-out Hush. In the meantime, I'll take care of the pollution here.

steps.speaker: HUSH Combat Force
steps.content: You're a Sinner who's been adjusted by X, equally untrustworthy. Eliminate all, eliminate—?!

steps.speaker: HUSH Combat Force
steps.content: A new Schorl? Why is it with you?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Conditions in the Observatorium are abnormal. Update instructions:  Emergency recover X and preserve her life.</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Central pollution levels are critical. HUSH unit, assemble to neutralize another S-Class Sinner. Rahu, recover X and eradicate all originating contaminants. Report any anomalies.</color>

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Understood.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Another Sinner...</color>

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The MBCC tracking team has reached the outskirts. Taking her out now would be too risky. I recommend relocating and, if needed, employing memory alteration via the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Although very subtle, she too bears X's <color=#fb9259>Mark</color>.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>...An unnecessary move. Then hand her over to the MBCC. This accident has cost too much. It's time to stop the losses. All our forces should be reserved for the Underground. Now, move.</color>
Footsteps draw near.
Is it... Rahu?
Christina strains to open her eyes, struggling to discern her surroundings.
Before seeing Rahu, Christina is first struck by a scene that floods her with nostalgia, rendering her mind a blank slate.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You... saved me?

As she speaks, she sees a radiant white light enveloping her. She senses something deep within being stirred, as her wounds miraculously start to mend. An unsettling awareness seeps into her thoughts, leaving Christina overwhelmed with dread.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: No, no! You're wielding your powers on me—you're trying to control me. Release me! I don't want your salvation; I won't be shackled by you again—

Christina forcefully shoves the woman before her, who stumbles backward like a hollow shell, terrifying the young girl who immediately clings to her in sheer terror. The light around them fades; the eyes of Hush grow increasingly vacant, until nothing remains but a chilling triangular insignia in her pupils.
Christina's mind is in chaos. Is she being manipulated? Despite her best efforts, she finds herself helplessly pulled back into the past—into memories deeply etched in the recesses of her soul.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Justice exists, without a doubt. I've seen it with my own eyes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: In another pure, real world... where every facet of the human heart is laid bare... there, I saw justice... and it exists forever...

steps.speaker: Young Christina
steps.content: Its exists forever... Does it mean it's very strong? Is it strong enough to defeat evil?
The woman's laughter fills the air as her captivating smile takes form. Shalom leans in toward Christina, her head gently finding rest on the young girl's shoulder.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Occasionally, it is strong, but it's often frail. We live in a far-from-perfect era where many tend to believe the harsher side of things; chaos, in its own unsettling way, provides some certainty and comfort.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But there will always be those who need it: the downtrodden, the brave, those unwilling to submit. I don't think it's naive...
Words momentarily wrap around Christina in a gentle embrace before departing.
The white light that had filled her with dread finally vanishes, and yet Christina finds herself irresistibly pulling the woman leaning against her into a tight embrace.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This isn't naive... it's your defiance against this world of chaos...
She suddenly hugs the woman in her arms tightly, gripping her hard. In her mind, she realizes, "As a detective, there's still something I need to take care of." Right then, Christina cries out.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Coquelic, I'll keep my word. So listen up, remember every word I say!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: My father, Marshall Collins, served as an instructor for FAC-G42. He gave his life in the Eclipse Operation, back in N.F. 103. For his sacrifice, he earned the FAC's Second-Tier Heroic Medal. I pay my respects to him every year, and I'm always proud of him!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Survive, and save them from whatever hell they're in. If you can't find them, come looking for me. Rest assured, I will never give up. Got it?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Get out of my way!

Coquelic grasps the situation, and a sudden surge of strength flows through her grievously wounded body. With a swift swing of her floral sword, she repels the elite HUSH forces before her and breaks through their lines, never once looking back. She is not driven by revenge; no one could now stand in the way of the Garden's Mentor.
Rahu watches as Coquelic departs, shaking off the grime from her shield. With Mania now quelled, Rahu turns and heads toward Christina.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: She heard and she left. She's not the kind of woman who can be held back.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Let her go, Chris. Paradeisos needs Shalom; entrust her to me, everything will be fine.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Even if you feel powerless to change anything right now, you're not alone; there's still a long road ahead.
The guard in black extends her hand to take Shalom's limp body, and Christina holds onto her tightly until the very last moment.
Under the watchful eye of the new Schorl and encircled by the stoic HUSH squad, Christina has never loathed her own intuition more.
Her detective instincts tell her that Shalom won't be coming back; some things must be said now.
Up to this point, I still can't tell if you've been truthful or deceptive, nor can I come to terms with what you've done to me.
Yet I still have feelings for you, still don't want to leave... Could this, too, be a manipulated emotion? Can something controlled feel so genuine?

If I could return to that day and speak to my past self, I'd still convince her to trust you, to believe in the justice you spoke of... Even if it were a lie, you returned that belief to me when I needed it most, allowing me to get to where I am now.
I really, really like you, Shalom.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hush Shalom, I know I can't catch you, nor do I have the power to stop your evil acts. But...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I will relentlessly pursue you, scrutinize your every action, and expose your hidden schemes. One day, I'll unveil the truth you've been covering up.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I'm not yet strong enough to mete out justice, but... someday, someone will be.
I will bring you back...

Shalom has lost her sense of hearing. Her body, weak and fragile, can no longer sustain her. A glowing blue triangle plunges her consciousness into an abyss, pulling her away from Christina and leaving even the chill of her body behind.
In the end, what lingers is her enigmatic, forever inscrutable smile.

August 26, N.F. 113
The West District's Black Ring defense line
is now fully operational.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: The August War is over. FAC has successfully built the BR-002 anti-Mania barrier, thereby halting its corruptive spread. We will not forsake the West District, and we shouldn't.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: As long as we purge the existing corruption within the city, there will come a day when order is restored in the West District, and both sides of the Rust will be reconciled. Until that day arrives, FAC will hold the line against Mania.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: This is the shared hope of all heroes who have fallen in this mission.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: May our city-state be free from suffering, may our fellow citizens be forever safe.
Blue Rain falls, enveloping the cemetery in silence. Coquelic trudges toward the direction she remembers.
Her body somewhat recovers. Uncertain if it's an aftereffect of having been controlled, her mind faintly echoes Shalom's words.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Set him free, Coquelic.
"Annoying Hush, still holding something back even now..." Coquelic forcefully shakes her head, banishing the noise from her thoughts.
There are more pressing matters, things she truly cares about, as she desperately heads toward the hazy location imprinted in her memory.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: N.F. 103... the 79th... it's at... <color=#fb9259>the Fifth Cemetery</color>...
She stumbles in clumsily, heading for the Hero Monument to search for the name Christina pointed out, in hopes of finding the clue they had talked about.
No need to search any further.

A figure suddenly lunges forward to embrace Coquelic, spilling the evidence, map, and intelligence papers she is holding onto the ground. She bursts into unrestrained tears. Those are the records of the Paradeisos approved "assignments" that the Garden assassins marked by X may have taken on.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: You don't have to do this. I know where they are. I'll go find them, I swear!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Really... You found them...?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Why are you crying... Trying so hard... You're such a fool...

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: The HUSH system is compromised. The Rules have shattered, Mania has extensively breached our <color=#fb9259>Second Observatorium</color>. The area is now impenetrable and beyond repair, demanding urgent containment measures. We've lost all monitoring of the BR-002 field.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Based on the final logs from Schorl, the enemy S-Class Sinner obliterated our on-site HUSH forces. She sabotaged Schorl before it could neutralize X, damaging <color=#fb9259>X's</color> physical form as a result and making a forced entry into her mental realm.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: With just a month left in her service period, X was set to be safely decommissioned and destroyed, and a replacement was already lined up. She was intended to be the most impeccable Hush, but she was sabotaged by the enemy in the eleventh hour, compromising even the entire Observatorium.

<color=#fb9259>??-04</color>: It's <color=#fb9259>the Underground</color>! In July, they discovered the HUSH system and recognized its significance. They immediately dispatched assassins to sabotage our operations. The attacker was none other than the notorious Mentor from the Garden, who alone has the power to defeat Schorl, dismantle X, and infiltrate the Observatorium.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: I'm familiar with the Mentor from the Garden. She's powerful, but not to this extent.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: X couldn't have possibly interacted with the Rift herself. In theory, even those S-Class Sinners can't breach the Rules sealing off X, much less rupture the Rift in the <color=#fb9259>Observatorium</color>. Unless...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The Mentor experienced some form of <color=#fb9259>trigger</color>, inducing a Mania outbreak.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Pull up all the data on X since her activation, every record for each piece of Schorl, and any data synchronized while she was monitoring. Then run a comprehensive analysis.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: Analysis complete.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: For the past 9 years, X has excelled in every assignment, with all deviations staying within safe limits. Her crisis responses have been spot-on, and every optimized plan has proven to be sound and justifiable upon further validation. There's been no sign of self-awareness, and no Level 5 or higher alerts have ever been triggered by Schorl during its operation.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: She's more than reliable—losing her would be a major setback. This definitely works in favor of the Underground; they've managed to turn the tables.
<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: But indeed, there's an inconsistency that's hard to justify.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: X has twice used her <color=#fb9259>Mark</color> ability on the same low-tier Sinner, yet hasn't fully assimilated her.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The first instance could be chalked up to X's initial field test, where she observed the development of a young Sinner. The second use of her Mark ability, however, lacks any logical reasoning.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The marked individual doesn't warrant such attention from X—be it skill, qualifications, potential, or obedience. It simply defies rational justification.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: Are you implying that the <color=#fb9259>Mark</color> ability we developed has inadvertently contaminated the Hush, leading her to manifest an unneeded emotional crack?

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: The odds are low, but we can't entirely dismiss the possibility. The Mark technology is, after all, a mere mimicry of the Underground <color=#fb9259>Shackles</color>, an object tainted with Manic Entity forcibly integrated into X. We can't overlook the chance that this coerced Mania resonance might negatively impact the Hush.

<color=#fb9259>??-03</color>: I recommend halting the Mark system's usage until we can verify these claims.

<color=#fb9259>??-07</color>: But, if she's truly betraying us, she's likely trying to deceive us intentionally! She aims to discredit the <color=#fb9259>Mark</color> system, a notion I can't accept.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: ...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Well, anything you do seems to make sense, given who you are, and your Manic Entity...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: <color=#fb9259>X</color>, you have a good understanding of us, too.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: You're aware that your opinions don't concern me.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Excessive skepticism about others' intentions carries its own emotional pitfalls. Rationality looks only at the facts. It is known that prior to the intrusion, all X's actions result in the fulfillment of the demand with no additional risk exposure. As for perceptual concepts like motivation...

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Whether X is showing cracks due to Marking the Sinner, strategically creating distractions to halt the Mark technology research, or even scheming to disrupt the HUSH system transition... Given that so many systems have failed around her, we now have a unique case study to help locate vulnerabilities and enhance out future developments.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: She has become the ideal subject for advancing the HUSH system.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Seal the backup and X until the Second Observatorium is reconstructed. Afterward, proceed with the transfer and decommissioning. This should be a quick process.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Both the HUSH system and Mark technology come with their own set of risks. Until we've pinpointed the exact cause of X's anomaly, exercise extreme caution when utilizing either.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Conveniently, she has recently completed the rigorous vetting of an S-Class Sinner, and her performance has been exceptionally stable. Retain the Marked subject, position her accordingly. By closely monitoring her stability, we can approximate the current status of X.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Use the waiting time to prioritize rooting out the spies. The breach of HUSH intelligence to the Underground is the gravest situation we're facing.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: The impending cataclysm at the Second Black Ring is unavoidable. Our defense grid is useless against it, and the Underground is gearing up for action. A struggle for control is inevitable. SHP-13 isn't just necessary, it's crucial—and the Underground will soon get the message.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Collect all of X's observational data from the past six months; it'll give us the edge we need. Find SHP-13, stick to the original plan, and wipe out the Underground Shepherd.

<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Paradeisos has already lost a "valuable tool"; let's wring every last drop of worth from what she left behind.
<color=#fb9259>??-02</color>: Take the HUSH-X channel offline until the day it comes back on.
...You know nothing about tools.

The guard in black places the dormant woman into the Restoration Chamber, observing her submerge into the cerulean regeneration liquid. This healing elixir gradually mends the severe cracks across her form, forever sealing away her perilous awareness.
Then, HUSH-X sinks to the bottom, vanishing into obscurity much like her unspoken, authentic self.
You've succeeded; no one will take your place, nor will anyone seek to destroy you. From now on...
Hm, forget it. Even if I were to ask, you'd simply tell me to go alone, without a backward glance.
I won't let you die, nor do I need you to serve as my tool. But thank you for bringing me to this point, for setting the stage.

Turning away, she leaves the room. Behind her, the door closes with a thud. Alone, Rahu wanders the vacant halls of Paradeisos, encountering one vaguely unfamiliar face after another. She moves through them with a quiet calm, committing each to memory just as peacefully.
Indifferent, arrogant, uneasy, dissatisfied... Rahu takes note of each face in her heart.
This is the reality behind the curtain. Who's pulling the strings, what they're doing, what they're after... I'm watching, and I'll see the truth.

steps.speaker: Blurry Figure
steps.content: Keep running, Rahu. Keeping running, that's the meaning of life.
Then, one day...
I like flowers.
Unyielding to the mire, untrapped by the narrow gaps, they yearn for the sun, blossoming in a grand spectacle that occurs but once in their lives.
I admire them, for being destined for futility, yet they still swim against the tide; for being destined to wither, yet they live marching towards death.
Even if they are plucked by someone, they can still freely...
At the FAC Memorial Cemetery before dawn, Christina encounters an unexpected figure after sending a lengthy letter of gratitude to Inspector Dole.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Ah, so you're still alive.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: How dare you show your face here? Where's Coquelic? Shouldn't she be the one thanking me?

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: ...You really haven't changed, still as audacious as ever.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: The Mentor's swamped, so I'm relaying a message for her: "Any promotions yet? Proven yourself reliable? What's your case clearance rate? How many perps have you nabbed? You still dragging down your mentor?"

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ahem!! Enough, enough... I'm off duty today; so... no solving cases!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: My little sister is returning to school. She's been away for too long, and I'm concerned she'll get picked on when she's back. I have to take her.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Then... people from MBCC will come for me. My knowledge is still limited, my power inadequate. To grasp what I truly desire, there's still a long way to go...

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: You got nabbed, didn't you? Washed out before you could even make the cut as a full-fledged detective?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: It's a reassignment! Not a demotion! I'm being sent to train and lend a hand! They need a formidable detective like me to help track people down!

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Ah, later on, I'll be heading to the <color=#fb9259>West District</color> with the Mentor. It seems that's where our companions from the Garden have all ended up. So, you won't have a chance to catch us or even locate us again. I thought you should know before I go.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: My quest for vengeance has come to an end. I no longer need to live as an assassin. From now on, I'll remain in the Garden that brings me the most peace, guarding it for all eternity.
She smiles, radiant as a blossom, before gracefully vanishing into the closing embrace of the night.
Christina remains solitary in the tranquil cemetery, as the rain prepares to cease.
Amidst a crowd adorned with the mantle of "heroes," the young girl greets the day's first break of light.
